inputs.label: Enable notifications
inputs.hint: Toggle to pause or resume all alert delivery without losing your configuration.

inputs.label: Check interval
inputs.hint: How often (in seconds) the daemon evaluates thresholds across all cluster nodes. Minimum 5 s.

inputs.label: Webhook type
inputs.hint: Choose the platform that should receive the alert. You can add multiple destinations.

inputs.label: Webhook URL (Discord)
inputs.hint: Create one at Discord › Server Settings › Integrations › Webhooks.

inputs.label: Webhook URL (Microsoft Teams)
inputs.hint: Create one via a Teams channel › Connectors › Incoming Webhook.

inputs.label: Webhook URL (Slack)
inputs.hint: Create one at api.slack.com/apps › Incoming Webhooks.

inputs.label: Enable email alerts
inputs.hint: When enabled, alerts are also sent via SMTP to the configured addresses.

inputs.label: Use TLS / STARTTLS
inputs.hint: Enable for most providers (Gmail, Outlook, etc.).

inputs.label: SMTP username
inputs.hint: Leave empty if your server does not require authentication.

inputs.label: SMTP password
inputs.hint: App password for Gmail/2FA. Stored in MongoDB.

inputs.label: From address
inputs.hint: Sender address shown in alert emails.

inputs.label: Metric to monitor
inputs.hint: The eBPF metric that will be evaluated against the threshold value.

inputs.label: Granularity level
inputs.hint: Aggregation scope. 'Pod' alerts per workload; 'Node' rolls all pods together.

inputs.label: Node filter (optional)
inputs.hint: Restrict this rule to one specific node. Leave blank to alert on any node in the cluster.

inputs.label: Threshold value
inputs.hint: An alert fires when the measured value exceeds this number. Unit depends on the metric selected above.
